scope: Explicit owned IPv4 localhost simulation and background read-only Qj status; no instrument endpoint, account permission, task, configuration or mechanical command

references.rules: One request in flight; monotonic deadline; one retry; late valid observation cannot reverse a failed request; generation cancellation
LocalHost/NoProxy only; bounded decode/write queues; actual wireReceived; socket callbacks reject stale generations
Existing local experiment uses 120ms/one retry and 1000ms query interval
Existing parseStatus and StatusSnapshot field validation reused without device side effects
Independent synthetic Qj query/status golden bytes; not an instrument capture
Original Qj model/main/LED/error fields; automatic calibration/configuration/login/time-setting chains are excluded

local_contract.endpoint: Worker creates QTcpServer on QHostAddress::LocalHost port 0, then connects only its serverPort; controller exposes no host/port argument
local_contract.query: Qj only; 120ms timeout, one retry, 1000ms poll, no concurrent requests
local_contract.threading: Client/transport/socket/server/timers are created and used in worker; controller only forwards queued values
local_contract.wire: TX is bytes actually read by owned peer; RX is bytes actually read by client. Each <=4096-byte event is logged before GUI forwarding; neither proves instrument ACK
local_contract.bounded_delivery: Latest state plus one queued state; wire ring <=128 events/65536 bytes plus one <=16-event/16384-byte outstanding batch. Overflow logs the actual bytes then explicitly stops with error
local_contract.shutdown: Stops polling and client, closes peer/server without GUI ack; direct thread-safe quit and locked final value allow shutdown after app.exec; run invalidation rejects stale queued state
local_contract.fault_injection: Only protected worker replyStatus override in independent tests; no product CLI/UI fault mode

unverified: resource budget and same-board real-time interference
